abstract: Published online: 22 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78954-3 Turning captured carbon dioxide into useful chemicals can save energy, but combining capture and conversion is difficult. Here, the authors report a membrane reactor converts bicarbonate solutions directly into carbon monoxide with high carbon efficiency and lower energy use.

abstract: Published online: 22 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78168-7 Understanding the solid–electrolyte <mark>interphase</mark> formed on <mark>lithium</mark> is vital for improving the lifetime of <mark>lithium</mark> metal batteries. Here, authors show that angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy can reveal the depth-dependent composition of the interfacial layer without damaging it by ion sputtering.
